newsitem.title: USA: Northwest sets major marketing initiative.
newsitem.headline: Northwest sets major marketing initiative.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Tuesday it will hold briefing by teleconference on Wednesday at 1100 CDT to announce a major marketing initiative.
A Northwest spokeswoman declined to provide any more information.

The teleconference will include remarks by James Lawrence, executive vice president and chief financial officer; Michael Levine, executive vice president marketing and international; and Tim Griffin, senior vice president market planning and systems.
